instruction: In the LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet, insert a new row after row 1 (the header row). In cell A2 of this new row, enter the text "Median", and in cell E2, calculate and enter the median value of all original data in column E (which will now be in rows 3 to 15 after the insertion). Save the file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires inserting new row and calculating median of column E. Verified with Python: median([664, 712.8, 761.6, 786, 908, 956.8, 1005.6, 1054.4, 1103.2, 1152, 1396, 1640, 1884]) = 1005.6 (middle value of 13 sorted values). After inserting row 2, original data moves to rows 3-15. Evaluator checks if cell E2 contains the median value.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction has 4 requirements (insert row, add 'Median' text to A2, calculate median in E2, save file) but evaluator only checks cell E2 value
Cannot verify row insertion: Evaluator would incorrectly pass if user just overwrites existing row 2 with value 1005.6 without actually inserting a new row
Missing verification of cell A2: No check that cell A2 contains the text 'Median' as required by instruction
Cannot distinguish calculation vs manual entry: Evaluator only checks the final value, not whether it was calculated with a formula or manually typed
Critical logical flaw: Evaluator cannot differentiate between partial completion and full completion of the multi-step task
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification for cell A2 to check it contains 'Median' text
Add verification to ensure a row was actually inserted (e.g., check total row count increased, or verify original data shifted down to rows 3-15)
Consider checking multiple cells to ensure row insertion occurred correctly (e.g., verify original row 2 data is now in row 3)
Implement multi-check evaluator with partial credit: 0.33 for A2='Median', 0.33 for correct E2 value, 0.34 for row structure verification
